text:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy kickstarted for release/2026-03-15 feature-branch B -> canary cohort 1 (10%). Scheduled DB migration: 20260315_enum_users_role.sql (non-blocking transactional).

maya: alerted by Sentry — elevated 500s on /users/create. Only canary traffic.

ben: posting error from app logs (canary-instance-7):
```
Exception: invalid input value for enum users_role: "senior_writer"
Trace: models/user.go:line 213
```

lina: that enum change shouldn't be live yet. Was this migration applied?

dbops-eli: checking DB. On canary shard I see partial apply — enum type created but constraint add failed. There's a long-running transaction id=5512 holding a SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE lock.

ben: psql snapshot:
```
pid  | age   | state   | query
-----+-------+---------+-----------------------------------
5512 | 00:07 | idle in tx | SELECT pg_sleep(300); -- healthcheck?
5520 | 00:01 | waiting | ALTER TYPE users_role ADD VALUE 'senior_writer';
```

maya: ohhh healthcheck connection left in open transaction? we've seen that before with the sidecar test harness.

dbops-eli: that explains lock. But weird that the migration runner targeted the wrong shard group — canary runner is configured for isolated shards but pipeline routed to a mixed shard tag.

oncall-bot: page core oncall. Incident created INC-20260315-12 :rotating_light: 

oncall-bot: severity P1 — oncall, please respond.

maya: oncall here, ack. I'm opening a console. Ben, can you confirm whether write failures are causing retries or failing fast?

ben: failing fast: user create returns 500 with enum parse error. About 12% of production-ish writes (traffic routed to canary) affected. No signs of silent retry loops yet.

cust-ops: compiling impact: customers in canary orgs may see account creation fail. Which tenants are in canary? we need a short blurb to comms.

lina: quick mitigation: roll feature gating back for canary cohort. Feature flag name: rollout.users_role_update.

ben: sample toggle (flags service):
```
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLAG_TOKEN" \n  https://flags.internal/flags/rollout.users_role_update -d '{"targets": {"cohorts": ["canary1"], "default": false}}'
```

cust-ops: doing now.

cust-ops: 200 OK — flag removed for canary cohort. Confirmed on app side: new requests use old code path. 500s drop to baseline.

dbops-eli: I'll terminate the stuck backend 5512 and mark the migration as aborted on canary. We'll also restore the pre-migration snapshot for the materialized view that was partially rebuilt.

(dbops-eli runs)
```
SELECT pg_terminate_backend(5512);
-- result: t
-- restore: restored snapshot snap_canary_pre_20260315
```

ben: after restore, confirm app can write again. Verified writes succeed on canary instances. No customer data loss observed.

maya: good. Now stop the release and flip the pipeline to manual for DB steps. We need a root cause: how did the migration runner pick mixed shards?

lina: looks like a regression in the deploy templating where shard_selector was defaulting to "all" instead of honoring canary_shard tag when migration=true. I'll open a pipeline bug.

dbops-eli: immediate actions I'm taking: 1) add allowlist check in migration-runner to refuse to run unless shard_selector==canary_tag for canary channel; 2) add preflight check that fails the job if any open idle-in-tx connections exist for >5s; 3) mark migration 20260315 as blocked until a safe rollout is planned.

maya: I'll coordinate a short postmortem, include timeline and mitigation. Lina, can you add an automated CI test that simulates an idle-in-tx healthcheck during DDL to ensure we catch this?

lina: on it.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-20260315-12 update: mitigated, paging paused, monitoring in watch mode.

cust-ops: drafting status: "We detected an issue during a canary database migration which caused enum parsing errors for a subset of requests. The canary release was paused and a rollback was applied; no customer data loss is suspected. Engineers are implementing additional checks to prevent this from reoccurring."

maya: follow-ups: 1) fix templating bug and gate migration-runner (dbops-eli); 2) add preflight + CI regression (lina); 3) run controlled retry of migration against an isolated staging shard with simulated app traffic (maya/ben).

dbops-eli: created DB ticket DB-989: "migration-runner allowlist + idle-conn preflight".

lina: created infra ticket INFRA-334: "CI regression: simulate idle-in-tx during DDL".

maya: scheduling postmortem for tomorrow 10:00. Thanks all, staying around for any follow-ups.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-20260315-12 closed for active paging. Watchers remain in channel for 2h.

ben: adding commands used to runbook for future oncall:
```
# remove flag for cohort
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLAG_TOKEN" \n  https://flags.internal/flags/rollout.users_role_update -d '{"targets": {"cohorts": ["canary1"], "default": false}}'

# terminate blocking backend
SELECT pg_terminate_backend(5512);

# restore snapshot label for canary
-- restore completed from snap_canary_pre_20260315
```

maya: posting short internal note and adding owners to postmortem doc. If anyone sees regressions, please @oncall.
